title: Rethinking in Spikes: Mitigating Hallucinations in MDLMs with Step-Aware Decoding
code_status: 作者项目https://mdlm-steprefine.github.io/当前无法取得内容；固定v1无代码仓库链接，未确认原作者实现开源。
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.multimodal.steprefine import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42))'

cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.data_scale: 12 multimodal task groups/benchmarks including POPE, MMHalu, MathVista and MMK12
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: 4 backbones, 256-token generations, total 256 denoising forward passes per sample, multiple method/threshold ablations
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: The full image/model/benchmark matrix is long-running and requires large checkpoints; only array-level equations and budget accounting are executed.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅保留entropy spike、概率加权embedding、KL停止与固定预算记账，不声称降低真实VLM幻觉。

summary: 检测mask平均熵相对历史变化窗口的异常上升，在这些步骤用概率加权embedding细化；按新分布到前一分布的KL停止，并从原去噪预算扣除额外前向。本地是CPU公式组件，不是MDLM生成。
